items.title: Genomes.io Taps Bittensor’s NIOME (SN55) to Speed Up Gene Therapy Discovery
items.body: Genomes.io uses NIOME (SN55) to model genetic variation with synthetic genomic data and predict who could benefit from gene therapies before testing in the lab.

items.title: Bittensor Expands Subnet Limit to 160, Opening the Door for More AI Builders
items.body: Bittensor raises its subnet limit from 128 to 160. Here's what the 32 new slots mean for builders, emissions and TAO demand, plus James Altucher's take.

items.title: TPN-009 Wants to Make Google’s Gemma 4 Small Enough for Home Computers
items.body: TPN-009 challenges Bittensor miners to compress Google’s Gemma 4 26B A4B IT to under 14 GiB while meeting performance benchmarks to make it easier to run on…

items.title: Which Bittensor Subnets Turn Customer Revenue Into Alpha Buybacks?
items.body: See which subnets turn customer revenue into alpha buybacks, how Lium, Targon, and Almanac compare, and how much of their buybacks absorb emissions.

items.title: AI Agents Keep Missing Cheaper, High-Quality Options Until Optia (SN47) Showed Up
items.body: Optia helps brands track AI recommendations across ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity, see which competitors get mentioned, and improve their visibility.

items.title: What the Chain Says About Gamma: $47.7K Spent, but Bittensor’s New Economy Is Just Getting Started
items.body: On-chain data reveals how Gamma is taking shape on Bittensor, with $47.7K in spending and a new model for inter-subnet payments.
